provenance.required_read_rule: Every shared input, every route-specific input, and every allowed method file is required—not merely allowed. Runtime parity is exact across all six generated replicates.
provenance.attempt_rule: Exactly one completed generation attempt per arm and replicate unless the frozen Arm B fairness repair is activated for a complete replacement cohort.
provenance.current_runtime_limit: The available worker surface can be orchestrator-attested but does not export tamper-evident actual-read traces. It cannot earn RUNTIME_OBSERVED registration authority.

intermediate_machine_contract.revision_directive: Every method audit contains at least one adjacent `- Replace: <verbatim initial line>` and `- With: <verbatim final line>` pair. The before line must disappear and the after line must be newly present.

arm_a.scoring_note: Arm A is diagnostic context, not an output-equivalent comparator.

execution_protocol: Luke produces an initial three-opening set from the shared context under the constrained output contract.
Matthew audits that same set for Hook, Flow, Close, and Voice without seeing Kyle artifacts.
Luke receives only Matthew's bounded audit and performs one revision in the same cold replicate.
A deterministic format-and-truth check runs; it may reject but not creatively rewrite the output.
excluded: Kyle transcript, ledger, workflows, prompt cards, and prior arm outputs

execution_protocol: Kyle workflows 01–03 produce an initial three-opening set from the shared context plus the route-specific breakdown lock.
Kyle workflow 04 audits that same set without reading baseline methods or outputs.
Kyle workflow 03 receives only the bounded first-four audit and performs one revision in the same cold replicate.
A deterministic format-and-truth check runs; it may reject but not creatively rewrite the output.

parity_invariant: Arms B and C receive identical Product Truth, audience, action, five swipes, task wording, output contract, parent model, and runtime settings. Route-specific method files differ by definition and remain mutually excluded.
fairness_rerun_rule: If Arm B misses the 65 floor because a required owner, support audit, revision, or format step was absent, repair that protocol once and rerun all three Arm B replicates. Never repair the prose from evaluator preferences and never add Kyle material.
